authentication.note: No authentication needed for free template tools and check_status. A Bearer API key (or ?token= query param), issued from the Docracy Dashboard, unlocks find_documents.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Browse free-library and Marketplace templates by keyword.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Metadata, drafting hints, and prepare URL for one template slug.

tools.name: draft_from_template
tools.description: Return a drafting brief and prepare link; never auto-sends.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Look up the status of a Docracy signing chain from a sign or status link.

tools.name: find_documents
tools.description: Search your own Docracy documents by title or a signer's name/email/company.
